record.field: ai['result'] = record._ai_tool_save_context( title=title, need_summary=need_summary, product_category=product_category, budget=budget, deadline=deadline, delivery_location=delivery_location, )

Saves the general facts of the procurement request as soon as the user gives them. Only pass the parameters you learned; omitted parameters are left unchanged. Returns the full current state of the request.

Replaces the whole item list of the procurement request: always send every item, not only the changed ones. Each item carries its specification as attributes (name, required value, unit), specific to that kind of product. Mark an attribute mandatory only when a vendor offer without it would be unacceptable. Returns the full current state of the request, including the estimated cost against the budget.
AI Tool: Procurement - Set General Requirements

Replaces the general requirements that apply to the whole order rather than to one item: installation, certifications or compliance, packaging, after-sales service, payment terms... Always send the complete list.

Returns the current state of the procurement request (it may have been edited by the user in the form), the blocking gaps that prevent approving the specification, and the warnings (budget, delivery...).
AI Tool: Procurement - Mark Ready for Review
Sending the item list for review
Moves the request to review once the user confirmed the item list. Refused while blocking gaps remain: in that case, ask the user about them.
